name: workspace
//: The line-coverage floors, each enforced once over the union of the instrumented test runs of one invocation: Rust over every crate's (the journeys spawn the instrumented binary), Python over every Python project's. It depends on no test target, so only the suites a change selected run; `just check` clears the data, runs the affected tests and then reports. Also the supply chain and bootstrap.

options.command: bun run biome format nx.json biome.json package.json .claude workspace crates sdks tools npm
bun run biome format --write nx.json biome.json package.json .claude workspace crates sdks tools npm
